request: Audit boot units and cron for legacy GPG-Core references (no secret contents)

bounded_host_request.command: python3 -c 'import subprocess,os; paths=["/home/admin1/.config/systemd/user","/etc/systemd/system","/home/admin1/.config/cron"];paths=[p for p in paths if os.path.isdir(p)];r=subprocess.run(["grep","-RIlE","GPG-Core|secure_up.sh|gpg_core",*paths],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=14);print("BOOT_REFERENCES",r.stdout.splitlines()[:50],"COUNT",len(r.stdout.splitlines()));p=subprocess.run(["crontab","-l"],capture_output=True,text=True);print("USER_CRON_GPG_REFERENCE",any(t in p.stdout for t in ("GPG-Core","secure_up.sh","gpg_core")));print("GPG_PROJECT_EXECUTABLES",[v for v in os.listdir("/home/admin1/projects/GPG-Core/scripts")])'
